title: review follow-ups of PR #37594
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgV6i8jfWwSXjpWJrjA

Filing gate: ① (review follow-ups, one card per PR) · Source: fleet (Contract review record 7196010986 on PR #37594, N1 and out-of-diff notes, adopted at ACCEPT 7196077328)

## What happens

PR #37594 (Fixes #37352) makes the personal-view and attachment own-door `501` follow the request's language, like the print door. Its review read three more places on `main` where the same failure still answers in English only, or could again:

- [ ] **Two sibling doors still answer a fixed English `501`.** `packages/runtime/src/domains/comments.ts` (about :164-177, "The comment doors are not available: …") and `packages/runtime/src/domains/webhooks.ts` (about :120-133, "Webhook redelivery is not available: …") do not go through `OwnDoorBridge` and carry no catalog key. A `zh-CN`, `ja-JP` or `es-ES` request reads English there while the print, personal-view and attachment doors on the same kernel answer in its language. Expected: both sentences come from the operation-message catalog in the four locales, with English byte-identical.
- [ ] **`OwnDoorBridge.nounKey` is optional.** `packages/runtime/src/domains/own-door-bridge.ts`: all three shipped bridges now name one, so the English-only arm is reached only by the test's synthetic bridge. Expected: the field is required, so a fourth bridge cannot ship English-only.
- [ ] **English verb agreement.** The attachment sentence reads "The attachment removal and rename doors is not available". #37594 kept it byte-identical on purpose. Expected: "are", changed together in the bridge's `noun`, the catalog's `en` value and the test pins, with a changeset line saying the English moved.

Category ①: each item is a user-visible sentence in the wrong language or wrong grammar, or the type hole that let it ship.
Priority: p2. A missing-service `501` is an operator-facing edge, not a common user path.
Business reason: a non-English console user who hits one of these doors reads English where sibling doors answer in their language.
Reader: the ux i18n area (seat 2, s2-ux-T).
Dedupe: searched `own-door 501 language comments webhooks` and `review follow-ups of PR #37594` (open issues), 0 hits.
Related: #37352, PR #37594, #37273.
